chat_stream.note: SSE chunk id is chatcmpl-{request_id}; the start header x-request-id carries the same request_id.

chat_nonstream_allow.note: The 200 allow envelope sets NO x-request-id header (frozen GW35 golden shape); the id is in the body zeroshield.request_id and error.request_id. x-request-id IS set on block/error envelopes and on the SSE start.
